name: Daily pipeline digest — morning Telegram push notification
goal: Reduce operator oversight friction for the Apr 7 gate. A PM2 cron script fires daily at 07:00, reads real data (manual-posts.jsonl, publish-ledger.jsonl, experiments.jsonl, smoke-test-latest.json), and pushes a gate-progress digest to the owner via Telegram. Operator wakes up with current gate status without needing to /status or /gate manually.
rationale: Apr 7 Phase 1.5 gate requires 30 manual posts + 500 views. The operator must post daily to hit this target. Pull commands (/status, /gate) require remembering to ask. A daily push digest ensures the operator never misses the gate progress and knows exactly how many posts to make today.
swarm: NOT USED — single stdlib-only script + ecosystem.config.js edit. Direct write.

tasks.title: scripts/daily-digest.ts — morning digest push
tasks.description: Standalone ts-node script. Reads: workspace/scs001/manual-posts.jsonl (gate progress), workspace/scs001/publish-ledger.jsonl (pipeline output count), workspace/scs001/experiments.jsonl (top hook formula), reports/smoke-test-latest.json (last smoke test). Formats a digest message with gate progress, posts needed today, days until gate. Sends to OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID via Telegram sendMessage API. Uses only stdlib (fs, https, path). No external npm deps.

tasks.title: ecosystem.config.js — add kognai-daily-digest PM2 cron
tasks.description: Add a new PM2 app entry named 'kognai-daily-digest': script=./scripts/daily-digest.ts, cron_restart='0 7 * * *' (07:00 daily), autorestart=false, interpreter=node, interpreter_args='-r ts-node/register', env includes TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true. This runs the digest every morning.

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/validate-sprint-134.ts — validation
tasks.description: Validation script: (1) check scripts/daily-digest.ts exists and is non-empty, (2) check ecosystem.config.js contains 'kognai-daily-digest' entry with cron_restart '0 7 * * *', (3) dry-run the digest script with DIGEST_DRY_RUN=1 env var (prints message to stdout instead of sending to Telegram), (4) verify message contains gate section (posts/views/days).
